summary: The change does what was asked. The producer brief now has a "criteria_check: copy the line" section. It lists every accepted criterion as a bare line the producer can copy, and tells it to give one entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including criteria already satisfied. The change producer prompt points to this section. The shared producer prompt line and the CriterionCheckOutput doc no longer ask the producer to strip numbers and kind tags; they now say to copy the line. The send-back text moved into a function, send_back_text, so a test can check that it names each missing criterion's exact text. D116 in docs/decisions.md says the main cause was the display, with the schema doc and prompt wording also contributing. It cites the required code locations and lists the three alternatives. The before send-back rate is honestly marked not measured: records/ was absent from the producer's copy, so 0 of 6 records were read and all six are named. The note gives a repeatable way to compute the rate and says there are no jobs since the change, so no after rate yet. I ran the new athena-context and athena-core tests and the budgets test; all pass. Shared producer.md got shorter, the change verifier prompt is untouched, and the recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed. The only scope point is minor: run_pin_tests.rs changed but is not on the expected deliverables list. It holds tests only and was in the planned files.
